{{Top|leg}}
A '''magic wand''' was a slender stick or rod thought to have [[Magic/Legends|magic]] properties. It was used by magicians, conjurors and shamans to cast spells. On the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Forceful]] beings were known to use such rods. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], head shaman of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], possessed a [[Staff of Logray|magic staff]], a [[healing wand]], a spirit staff&mdash;that helped summon dead ancestors for asistance<ref name="SWV">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>&mdash;and a [[Logray's ceremonial wand|ceremonial wand]].<ref name="SSVSS">{{Ewoks|Sunstar vs. Shadowstone}}</ref><ref name="SSEA">''[[The Shadow Stone: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> The mysterious enchantress known as the [[Leaf Queen]] also held a shaft of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] that allowed her to perform various magical acts.<ref name="EWP">{{Ewoks|The Wish Plant}}</ref><ref name="ESS">{{Ewoks|The Season Scepter}}</ref>

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once thought wistfully that there was no magic wand that could make everything better, not even for a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
